alternate_names: St. James Church; St. James Cathedral

postfire_code_context: A post-fire masonry reconstruction retained documented surviving fabric rather than representing a wholly new identity.

architect_or_builder: John H. Edelmann and Joseph S. Johnston

postfire_code_context: Within the North Side fire limits; the permanent masonry project replaced a temporary tabernacle and roofed basement.

postfire_code_context: The July 1874 fire accelerated relocation southward; the replacement used substantial masonry construction.

canonical_name: All Saints Catholic parish first edifice

structural_system: substantial parish edifice; material not stated
postfire_code_context: Constructed after the 1874 citywide extension of fire limits; material should be confirmed from parish or permit records.
